# Owais Zahoor — Marketplace Operations Portfolio

> Owais Zahoor is an independent marketplace operations lead specializing in Amazon Vendor Central, Amazon Seller Central, Amazon advertising, Walmart marketplace support and portfolio leadership for brands and agency teams.

## Core services

- Amazon Vendor Central operations: purchase orders, ASN/ARN workflows, receiving investigation, deductions, catalog health, retail readiness, forecasting and reporting.
- Amazon Seller Central operations: catalog and listing health, account issues, promotions, inventory coordination, SEO and Amazon PPC.
- Walmart marketplace and advertising: Sponsored Products, search-term analysis, retail readiness, margin-aware budget allocation and reporting.
- Agency support: white-label delivery, fractional operations leadership, team training, quality control and scoped team build-outs.

## Selected brand and agency experience

Owais has supported the following brands and agencies through employer, agency and client-service engagements: Instant Pot, Euroitalia, Versace, Moschino, Atkinsons, Krikorian, Infantino, Wagner SprayTech, Kazai GmbH, Canton Aquatics, Crystal Quest, Kloobie, Evergreen Eco Tabs, Grown Ass Man Co., Alpha Lion, Clutch Ventures, Legion, Decibullz, Curvd, LifePro Fitness, Scanmarker, Commercekind, Current Commerce, Spectrum BPO, Full Circle Agency, Adcelerate 360, Chai Vision, Sellerexa and Hector AI.

Selected reported outcomes:
- Canton Aquatics: monthly Amazon US sales grew from $19K to $94K in six months while ACoS moved from 34% to 13.73%.
- Crystal Quest: created an interim copy listing during a suspension, then reactivated the original high-selling listing, reported at about $67K in monthly sales volume.

Brand names describe professional experience and do not imply formal endorsement or a direct independent-client relationship.
